doc.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29

title: Four-piece band at Brennan's and on WDSU television
summary: The men recall a four-piece Saturday television show and playing at Brennan's, with Jim's illness on a job.
